_note: PCAFormer sweep — frozen-PCA + vanilla time-axis transformer. The PCA basis (n_factors PCs) is the main regulariser; the transformer only models the PC-score dynamics, so it stays small. The smallest pair (d_model=4, d_ff=16) is train.py's hand-tuned anchor (n_factors=3, n_layers=1, dropout=0.3, revin_affine=off, lr=1e-3, wd=1e-3); the sweep stays close to it. d_model/n_heads/d_ff move together as pairs (d_ff=4*d_model) so head_dim and FFN width stay sensible — n_heads must divide d_model. The frozen basis is fit per-combo on the train windows before the first epoch.
